label: Text 1
transcript: "My name is Sam. First I get up at 6:30. Then I have breakfast at 7. Afterwards I leave home at 7:30. School starts at 8. I finish at 1:20."

label: Text 2
transcript: "On Sundays Lina wakes up late. First she has a long breakfast with her family. After that she meets Sam in the park. They play chess for an hour. Finally, in the evening, she does her homework."
